reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported database: SQLite driver better-sqlite3. Deployz hosts PostgreSQL and MySQL only; an embedded file database does not survive in the container model.
reviews.reason: The shown files do not reveal where better-sqlite3 is used, so they do not prove that the production app avoids SQLite.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /elk/data (Dockerfile), volume ./elk-storage:/elk/data (docker-compose.yaml elk)
reviews.reason: The production image points its storage at /elk/data on local disk and declares it as a persistent volume, and the only alternative drivers (Cloudflare or Vercel) are not storage Deployz provides.
